verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products programmatically, which covers the API route to catalog changes without the control panel. Nothing in the evidence shows bulk-specific endpoints, CSV import or export, or bulk-edit tooling, so the bulk part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: CSV import/export documentation, bulk-edit UI or batch API endpoints, export capability evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk catalog operations.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can bulk import, export, and edit the catalog — CSV or API — without touching products one at a time
